tools.name: search_guidelines
tools.description:
Look a rule up in the UMR guidelines (umr4nlp/umr-guidelines, guidelines.md).

keywords: terms to look for, e.g. "aspect", "modal strength", "have-rel-role-92", ":quant",
"reentrancy". Passages with more of the keywords come first, then those whose heading has
them, then those that mention them most.
max_results: how many passages to return (at most 10).

Returns {"sections": [{"heading": the passage's place in the guidelines ("Part 3. ... > Part
3-3-1. Aspect"), "text": the passage (a section, or a part of a long one)}], "found": how
many passages matched}.

tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

tools.name: search_annotations
tools.description:
Find how a case is annotated: gold UMR annotations of whole sentences.

language: "zh" (Chinese) or "en" (English).
keywords: words or pieces to look for, matched anywhere in a sentence or its annotation:
words of the text (e.g. "发生", "wanted to"), concepts ("have-org-role-91", "identity-91"),
roles (":ARG1-of", ":manner"), attribute values (":aspect state"). Sentences with more of the
keywords come first.
max_results: how many gold sentences to return (at most 10).

Returns {"gold": [{"doc", "sentence_number", "sentence", "annotation"}], where annotation is
the sentence's whole annotation (words, sentence-level graph, alignment, document-level
annotation); "found": how many gold sentences matched in all}.

## Input

Language: zh
Document: zh-0028, sentence 7 of 12

The previous sentences (at most five; number, tab, words):

2	而且 它 还 配备 了 D-Sub （ VGA ） ， HDMI 两 种 接口 ，

3	能够 在 拨接 电脑 设备 之 余 ， 还 能够 方便 用户 进行 PS3 、 Xbox360 、 蓝光机 等等 设备 的 连接 。

4	这 就 是 三星 B560 ， 你 值得 拥有 !

5	方形 机身 和 方形 的 底座 设计 ， 笔挺 的 立姿 ， 有点 像 大师 打座 的 气势 。

6	它 有 三 个 接口 ， 分别 为 电源 、 HDMI 、 VGA 。

Their graphs:

I annotated sentence 2 as follows:

- **Main predicate:** 配备 is PropBank `配备-01`. Its ARG0 is the agent, ARG1 the thing equipped and ARG2 the place it is fitted to. In 它配备了…接口, 它 is the device the ports are on, so I made it `:ARG2`, as in PropBank's examples. There is no agent. 它 is a 3rd-person singular `thing`.
- **Aspect:** 了 marks a completed event, so the aspect is `performance`.
- **而且 and 还:** both are `:mod` nodes. The gold examples of 而且 I found were partial conversions using `progression`, which isn't a standard concept, so I didn't follow them.
- **The ports:** 接口 has `:quant 2`. 种 is a classifier, so it gets no node. The search found no gold example with 接口 to copy.
- **The listed ports:** I put the two port types under `:mod` as an `and` of two named `product`s. "VGA" in brackets is an alternative name for D-Sub, so I attached it to D-Sub as another `:mod` product. Both are judgement calls. The list names every port, so an identity-style reading would also be defensible, and VGA could have been treated as a second name.

# ::snt 2
# sentence level graph:
(s2x / 配备-01
    :ARG2 (s2t / thing
        :refer-person 3rd
        :refer-number singular)
    :ARG1 (s2j / 接口
        :quant 2
        :mod (s2a / and
            :op1 (s2p / product
                :name (s2n / name :op1 "D-Sub")
                :mod (s2p2 / product
                    :name (s2n2 / name :op1 "VGA")))
            :op2 (s2p3 / product
                :name (s2n3 / name :op1 "HDMI"))))
    :mod (s2e / 而且)
    :mod (s2h / 还)
    :aspect performance)

# ::snt 3
# sentence level graph:
(s3f / 方便-01
    :ARG0 (s3t / thing
        :refer-person 3rd
        :refer-number singular)
    :ARG1 (s3u / 用户)
    :ARG2 (s3l / 连接-01
        :ARG0 s3u
        :ARG1 (s3s / 设备
            :example (s3a / and
                :op1 (s3p / product
                    :name (s3n / name :op1 "PS3"))
                :op2 (s3p2 / product
                    :name (s3n2 / name :op1 "Xbox360"))
                :op3 (s3b / 蓝光机)
                :op4 (s3e / et-cetera)))
        :aspect state)
    :temporal (s3b2 / 拨接-01
        :ARG0 s3t
        :ARG1 (s3s2 / 设备
            :mod (s3d / 电脑))
        :aspect state
        :modal-strength neutral-affirmative)
    :mod (s3h / 还)
    :aspect state
    :modal-strength neutral-affirmative)

# ::snt 4
# sentence level graph:
(s4a / and
    :op1 (s4i / identity-91
        :ARG1 (s4t / thing
            :mod (s4z / 这))
        :ARG2 (s4p / product
            :wiki "-"
            :name (s4n / name :op1 "三星" :op2 "B560"))
        :mod (s4j / 就)
        :aspect state)
    :op2 (s4z2 / 值得-01
        :ARG1 (s4y / 拥有-01
            :ARG0 (s4p2 / person
                :refer-person 2nd
                :refer-number singular)
            :ARG1 s4p
            :aspect state
            :modal-strength neutral-affirmative)
        :aspect state))

I read the sentence as "The square-body and square-base design and the upright posture look a little like the aura of a master sitting in meditation." The main predicate is 像-01 ("resemble"): its `:ARG0` is the thing being described (the design and the posture, joined with `and`) and its `:ARG1` is what it looks like (气势, "aura"). 有点 ("somewhat") is `:degree`, following a gold example with the same 有点 像 pattern.

Three choices are uncertain:
- **打座:** The sentence writes 打座, which is not in PropBank, so it is 打座-00. PropBank has the standard spelling 打坐 as 打坐-01, and the gold may use that instead.
- **设计 ("design"):** I treated it as an event noun, 设计-01 with `:aspect process`. The gold may instead treat it as a plain noun.
- **方形 and 笔挺:** Both are plain `:mod` modifiers here, not separate events.

# ::snt 5
# sentence level graph:
(s5x / 像-01
    :ARG0 (s5a / and
        :op1 (s5s / 设计-01
            :ARG1 (s5a2 / and
                :op1 (s5j / 机身
                    :mod (s5f / 方形))
                :op2 (s5d / 底座
                    :mod (s5f2 / 方形)))
            :aspect process)
        :op2 (s5l / 立姿
            :mod (s5b / 笔挺)))
    :ARG1 (s5q / 气势
        :mod (s5d2 / 打座-00
            :ARG0 (s5m / 大师)
            :aspect activity))
    :degree (s5y / 有点)
    :aspect state)

# ::snt 6
# sentence level graph:
(s6h / have-91
    :ARG1 (s6p / thing
        :refer-person 3rd
        :refer-number singular)
    :ARG2 (s6x / 接口
        :quant 3
        :unit (s6x2 / 个)
        :ARG1-of (s6i / identity-91
            :ARG2 (s6a / and
                :op1 (s6x3 / 电源)
                :op2 (s6x4 / HDMI)
                :op3 (s6x5 / VGA))
            :mod (s6x6 / 分别-01)
            :aspect state))
    :aspect state)

This sentence:

7	高清 的 HDMI 接口 成为 现在 市场 的 主流 ， 很 有 可能 HDMI 就 是 2012 的 一 个 趋势 ， 同时 还 保留 有 VGA 的 接口 ， 让 消费者 在 不同 需求 上 得到 满足 。

Its graph:

I read the sentence as three linked clauses, joined by `and`:
1. HDMI is now the market's mainstream.
2. HDMI is very likely to be a 2012 trend.
3. VGA ports are kept too, so consumers' different needs are met.

The senses come from Chinese PropBank. Five choices were judgement calls rather than checked rules:
- **很有可能 ("very likely")**: I put it on the second clause as `:modal-strength partial-affirmative` with no node of its own. A gold search for 很有可能 found nothing, and the gold examples of 可能 were not the same construction.
- **Satisfying needs**: I treated 得到满足 ("get satisfied") as plain `满足-01`, with the consumers as the ones satisfied (`:ARG2`) and their needs as `:ARG1`.
- **HDMI and VGA**: I annotated both as named entities of type `product`. I did not check this type in the guidelines or the gold data.
- **成为 ("become")**: I gave it `:aspect state`, reading "has become the mainstream now" as a current state.
- **Dropped words**: 就, 很 and 一个 have no node of their own; 同时 ("at the same time") is kept as a `:temporal`.

# ::snt 7
# sentence level graph:
(s7a / and
    :op1 (s7c / 成为-01
        :ARG0 (s7j / 接口
            :mod (s7g / 高清)
            :mod (s7p / product
                :name (s7n / name :op1 "HDMI")))
        :ARG1 (s7z / 主流
            :poss (s7s / 市场))
        :temporal (s7x / 现在)
        :aspect state)
    :op2 (s7i / identity-91
        :ARG1 (s7p2 / product
            :name (s7n2 / name :op1 "HDMI"))
        :ARG2 (s7q / 趋势
            :quant 1
            :temporal (s7d / date-entity :year 2012))
        :aspect state
        :modal-strength partial-affirmative)
    :op3 (s7b / 保留-01
        :ARG1 (s7j2 / 接口
            :mod (s7p3 / product
                :name (s7n3 / name :op1 "VGA")))
        :mod (s7h / 还)
        :temporal (s7t / 同时)
        :aspect state
        :purpose (s7r / 让-02
            :ARG1 (s7k / 消费者)
            :ARG2 (s7m / 满足-01
                :ARG1 (s7x2 / 需求-01
                    :ARG0 s7k
                    :mod (s7y / 不同)
                    :aspect state)
                :ARG2 s7k
                :aspect performance)
            :aspect performance)))

content.text:
I annotated six events and three time expressions in this sentence. I checked one point against the gold data: the 让-02 example. The other choices are judgement calls.

- **Time expressions:** 现在 ("now") is vague, so it hangs on `present-reference`. 2012 is an absolute date, so it hangs on `root`.
- **同时 ("at the same time") is a guess.** I hung it on `document-creation-time` and made keeping the VGA port overlap it. It could instead have been tied to the first clause.
- **Purpose clause:** I put 让 ("so that") after 保留 ("keep"), following the rule that a purpose comes after its main event.
- **Modal for 让 and 满足:** The author asserts 让, and 满足 ("satisfied") hangs under 让 as `unspecified`. This follows a gold example with 让-02. The guidelines also allow a `purpose` constant here, which I did not use.
- **很有可能 ("very likely"):** Its clause gets `partial-affirmative`, the same value as in the sentence graph.
- **Coreference:** The HDMI and VGA mentions link to the HDMI and VGA ports listed in sentence 6. One triple breaks the rules: the two HDMI nodes inside this sentence should be one shared node in the graph, not a `:coref` link. I kept the triple because the graph gives them separate nodes.

               (s7t :overlap s7b)
               (s7b :after s7r)
               (s7r :overlap s7m)

    :coref ((s6x4 :same-entity s7p)
